historical_note: These machine-readable decisions are frozen on 2026-10-28 after the original preregistered design and are not represented as having been preregistered earlier.

search_budget.b1_candidate_budget.justification: Matches the direct B3 candidate count already exercised in the compatibility preflight and makes the primary B1/B3 proposal-budget comparison symmetric.
search_budget.b1_candidate_budget.implementation_binding: B1 enumerates grammar ASTs in deterministic complexity order and stops after four emitted/evaluated candidates.

search_budget.b1_verifier_call_cap.justification: One verifier call is permitted per emitted candidate, bounded by the shared four-candidate proposal budget; no post-hoc extra search is allowed.
search_budget.b1_verifier_call_cap.implementation_binding: The verifier stops after four candidate-level calls and records every call.

b2_architecture.justification: Freezes the catalogue-scoring model already implemented and validated; B2 remains a Milestone 1 fixed-family integration arm, not a novelty claim.

b3_architecture.justification: Freezes the direct AST decoder that passed the compatibility gate; no architecture expansion is introduced.

optimizer_and_learning_rate.justification: Uses the optimizer families and rates exercised by the implementation compatibility paths, with the original 2,000-update maximum retained as the fixed final budget.

contradiction_fixture.justification: Makes the externally triggered v0 revision contract identical across arms without claiming that contradiction detection has been learned.

interference_fixture.failure_rule: any previously validated procedure changes output or becomes unavailable
interference_fixture.justification: Uses a fixed, task-independent probe set to measure retention interference without adding training information.

sealed_test_source.justification: The manifest already provides evaluator-only oracle rows; this amendment freezes the phase boundary rather than introducing a new test set.

checkpoint_selection_rule.justification: Prevents validation leakage and preserves the registered 2,000-update maximum.
